$comment: Track B route catalog (PRD §routes). The planner MUST pick exactly one route; timing envelopes are enforced when validating plan.json and when the editor validates a customer's scene-duration edit.

product_launch.label: Product Launch
product_launch.notes: Build anticipation before the reveal. The reveal is the single most important beat — give it the slowest, heaviest motion. End on one unmistakable CTA.

feature_update.label: Feature Update
feature_update.notes: Show the old state honestly, cut hard on the change, land the benefit in plain words.

product_tour.label: Product Tour
product_tour.notes: Generous pacing. Guide attention with zooms and annotations anchored to real UI regions — never a wall of screens. Scene durations vary deliberately; uniform pacing is an anti-goal.

comparison.label: Comparison
comparison.notes: Two-column or before/after. Fair presentation: both sides get equal visual weight until the verdict beat.

announcement.label: Announcement
announcement.notes: Text-forward and typography-driven. Motion carries the emotion; imagery is secondary.

$comment_bounds: Hard per-scene bounds the Product Editor enforces on customer timing edits, in addition to the planner's per-scene timing_range.
